name: indahl-quote-check
description: Check every quotation in a draft, article, report or another skill's output against its source, word for word: VERBATIM, ALTERED, PARAPHRASE_IN_QUOTES, MISATTRIBUTED, NOT_FOUND or CANNOT_TELL, with the source text beside it. Use before publishing anything that quotes a person, a document or a paper. Nothing is sent outside your session.
